sentences.text:
Counsel for Petitioner :- Satish Mishra Counsel for Respondent :- A.S.G.I.,Gaurav Kumar Chand Hon'ble Mrs. Sunita Agarwal,J.
Hon'ble Nand Prabha Shukla,J.
The present writ petition has been filed with the following prayers:-
"(A) Issue a writ, order or direction in the nature of mandamus commanding the respondents to make payment of compensation as commercial rate in accordance with provision of the Central Act No.30 of 2013 namely Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land, Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013 for the land of petitioner having Gata No.271 area 210 sq. meter situated at Village-Bhatewara, Tehsil-Bhadohi, District-Bhadohi.

sentences.text:
(B) Issue a writ, order or direction in the nature of mandamus, commanding the respondent no.3 to pay interest @ 18% per annum on the amount of compensation,
due till the date of actual payment, in respect of the petitioner's land, mentioned above in the prayer no.(A).
(C) Issue a writ, order or direction in the nature of mandamus commanding the respondent no.3 to decide the representation dated 29.10.2022 of the petitioner within stipulated time period as directed by this Hon'ble Court."

Sri Anand Tiwari, learned counsel appearing for the respondent nos. 3 and 4 and Sri Gaurav Kumar Chand, Advocate appearing for the respondent no.1 submit that the acquisition for the land in question is complete with the passing of the award dated 25.11.2021.
The final notification dated 04.08.2021 has been issued after giving notices to the land owners and the petitioner herein has not filed any objection to the same.
Be that as it may, there is no challenge to the acquisition proceedings.

The prayer in the writ petition is to grant compensation to the petitioner under Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land, Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013, and in the representation dated 29.10.2022 the petitioner seeks determination of compensation at the commercial rate.

entities.text: Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land, Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: Be that as it may, the claim of the petitioner for grant of compensation for a higher rate than that fixed in the award dated 25.11.2021 cannot be entertained to issue a mandamus.

It is open for the petitioner to challenge the award by taking recourse of Sub section (2) of Section 10 of the Petroleum and Minerals Pipelines (Acquisition of Right of user in Land) Act, 1962, by approaching the District Judge within whose territorial jurisdiction the land in question falls.

entities.text: Petroleum and Minerals Pipelines (Acquisition of Right of user in Land) Act, 1962
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: The writ petition is dismissed on the ground of alternative remedy.
